# CUDA-JS

> Public source index for LLMs and software agents. Read-only access requires no GitHub authentication.

## Primary entry points

- [README.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/README.md): project overview and documentation entry point.
- [EVIDENCE.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/EVIDENCE.md): evidence classes, claim scope, validation limits, and external-validation path.
- [AGENTS.md](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/AGENTS.md): repository-specific agent instructions and authority rules.
- [Agent access](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/.agent/ACCESS.md): anonymous access routes and precedence notes.
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/LICENSE): license terms.

## Evidence status

- Evidence registry: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/EVIDENCE.md
- Machine claims: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/evidence/claims.json
- External source grounding: the recorded official NVIDIA CUDA 13.3 package, cuda.h, cudaTypedefs.h, and package-license SHA-256 values were reacquired and all matched exactly.
- Scope: source/provenance identity only; this does not establish runtime correctness, Linux GPU qualification, performance, or third-party reproduction of CUDA-JS execution.

## Anonymous source access

- Repository: https://github.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS
- Git clone: `https://github.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS.git`
- Raw files: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/main/
- ZIP snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/zip/refs/heads/main
- tar.gz snapshot: https://codeload.github.com/iteathen/CUDA-JS/tar.gz/refs/heads/main

Prefer Git, raw HTTPS, or codeload over the GitHub REST API when possible. Follow repository-local authority and agent instructions.
